sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) | QwenLM/Qwen3-Coder | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document covers the Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) training system for Qwen3-Coder models. DPO is used to align model outputs with human preferences by training the model to increase the likelihood of preferred responses while decreasing the likelihood of rejected responses.
